Coordinate durable attempt cancellation (#190)

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-45
  description: |-
    ## Summary
    
    - Persist restart-safe Attempt cancellation coordination through exact interrupt, bounded inspection, sealed runtime closure, and cleanup handoff.
    - Expose `codeon_attempt_cancel` and `codeon_attempt_cancellation_status` through the exact MCP catalog.
    - Fence unknown runtime outcomes with recovery Attention and rotate scoped worker faults to preserve other repository progress.
    
    ## Verification
    
    - `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
    - `cargo check -p codeon-tracker -p codeon-postgres -p codeon`
    - `cargo test -p codeon-tracker attempt_cancellation`
    - `cargo test -p codeon --test mcp_catalog`
    - `cargo test -p codeon operation_tools_schemas_and_errors_are_operation_scoped_and_redacted`
    - `cargo clippy -p codeon-tracker --all-targets -- -D warnings`
    - `cargo clippy -p codeon-postgres --lib -- -D warnings`
    - `cargo test -p codeon-postgres --features postgres-acceptance --test execution_attempt_store --no-run`
    
    PostgreSQL acceptance execution was not available because `CODEON_TEST_DATABASE_URL` and isolated-database confirmation were unset.
